newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JAN 27.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JAN 27.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- With the junior coalition partner adding its voice, there is better chance now for reducing social security contributions of small enterpreneurs.
- Public sector employees asked the Prime Minister's help to secure their endagered March payrise.
- Opposition party Smallholders only sees cooperation with other opposition parties at consultation levels.
- Budapest police closed the unsolved case of an 1996 salmonella poisoning, which made ill 5,000 people.
- A hairdrier that exploded on Sunday was probably just malfunctioning and did not contain a bomb as earlier supposed.
